QUESTIONS, ANSWERED

Before you book.

Is this a live rental service?

No. This Phase 1 experience uses illustrative listings only. No booking, payment or verification can be completed here.

Can I choose self-drive or a chauffeur?

Vehicle eligibility will be shown on each approved listing. Final availability and customer eligibility will be validated by the backend in later phases.

How will safety and insurance work?

Operational checks and approved policy terms will be confirmed before launch. Mota does not claim cover for demonstration listings.
